title: App crashes
symptom: The app crashes immediately after starting, especially when starting a sensor or when a sensor has already been started. The issue occurred after updating to a newer version than the December 10 build, and was resolved after trying the latest version.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but it is suggested that the issue may be related to receiving too much data after updating to a newer version.
fix: The user reported that the latest version (with enhanced crash reporter) is working now, and after starting a new sensor it still works. The issue was closed as fixed.
evidence_quote: I have tried the latest version, it is working now, not crashing, still getting message about received to much data, but now it is working, waiting till tomorrow or friday if app is still working, it crashed last time also after starting a new sensor
